register_TargetCurrentSensor: register the TargetCurrentSensor to get ground truth object positions relative to the robot end-effector frame
register_JointSensor: register the JointSensor to observe the robot arm joint positions as a tensor observation
register_RobotForce: register the RobotForce measure to track accumulated and instantaneous collision force applied by the robot
register_ObjectToGoalDistance: register the ObjectToGoalDistance measure to compute Euclidean distance from each target object to its goal position
register_RearrangeReward: register the RearrangeReward measure to compute reward with collision penalties and force termination checks
